relations.statement: A receipt is accepted only if its authority effect equals the constant "None".
relations.hypotheses: receipt carries an authority effect field

relations.statement: The ReplayHash stored in a sealed folder equals replay_hash of the accepted bytes, so a reader reopening the bytes recomputes the same hash.
relations.hypotheses: hash function is deterministic; bytes unchanged since acceptance

lemmas.statement: A sealed folder built by G_seal_run_folder from accepted bytes b records replay_hash b and authority effect None.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem seal_custody (b : List UInt8) (h : List UInt8 → Nat) : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: A ReplayFiber hash of proposal bytes certifies or authorizes the proposal.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The docstring says the helper is not certification or authorization; authority effect stays None.

near_misses.claim: Naming a trace by its hash may rewrite the trace in place.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The append log sits beside the seal so traces are named without in-place rewrite.

open_obligations: No existing declaration found for ReplayHash, run-folder sealing, or issue_finite_receipt in @SRC, so those generators are proposed_new.
Several AUTHORITY_EFFECT_NONE constants exist in @SRC; the omega_replay one was not listed, so the finite_shadow_exact.rs citation is a stand-in.
Lean skeleton is a placeholder and does not yet encode the statement.
Append log and ReplayFiber were not modelled.
